cards.title: 52 playing cards
cards.profile: Choose a card count, shuffle and draw. Tap a card to reveal it, then tap again to see a larger image.
cards.revealHint: Tap each card to reveal it or choose Reveal all.
cards.complete: All cards are revealed. View a larger image or download the result.
cards.expired: This draw session has expired, so the server no longer keeps it. You can still reveal, view and download the result on this device; start a new session to draw again.
cards.meaningHint: Reveal each card to read its meaning and advice. Reveal all cards to see the overall conclusion. Readings are currently in Vietnamese.

numerology.title: Numerology
numerology.configure: Enter your birth date and name
numerology.name: Full name (optional)
numerology.consent: I agree to send these inputs to calculate my numbers. Names and birth dates are not stored in the database or account history.
numerology.method: Add the digits and reduce, keeping 11/22/33. Names use unaccented A–Z letters; AEIOU are vowels and Y is a consonant.

calendar.title: Sources and calendar download
calendar.method: Solar–lunar conversion uses Vietnam time (UTC+7), for years 1800–2199.
calendar.pending: This section provides solar–lunar conversion; traditional day-selection rules are not included.
calendar.checked: The lunar date matches the server result.
calendar.mismatch: The engines disagree. Send feedback for review before relying on this result.
calendar.source: Existing algorithm reference: Hồ Ngọc Đức; usage rights and golden reference data require validation before releasing extensions.

errors.NETWORK_ERROR: The request did not complete. Your input is retained; retry.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_NAME: Names may only contain Vietnamese or Latin letters, spaces, apostrophes (') and hyphens (-). Remove digits, symbols, emoji or other scripts, or leave the name empty.
errors.INVALID_BIRTH_DATE: The birth date is invalid, before 1800 or in the future.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: This session key expired. Start a new session.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This key belongs to another configuration. Start a new session.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait one minute and retry.
